summary.text: A 1984 Robert Trent Jones Sr. design among umbrella pines on the Estoril coast near Cascais, next door to Oitavos Dunes.

setting.text: Laid out on a 110-hectare pine estate on the Estoril coast, near Cascais and about 25 km from Lisbon.
Top100golfcourses says Jones laid it out among stands of pine trees on a flat property slightly inland from Guincho beach, with some fairways flanked by small holiday apartments.
Golfbreaks says it winds through umbrella pines and rolling terrain, with sea breezes and views of the Atlantic.
Portugalgolf.net says the course has elevated greens and tees, many bunkers and some water hazards, with views of the Atlantic and the Sintra mountains.
Where2golf describes it as tree-lined and open parkland on gently undulating, easy-to-walk terrain.

history.text: Opened in 1984, designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr.
Lisbonpackage.com says the course predates the resort hotel that grew up around it by about fifteen years.
The first big event was the Ladies Masters in 1988, on the European Women's Tour, won by Laurette Maritz-Atkins of South Africa.
In 2002 it hosted the Estoril Seniors Tour Championship, which Denis Durnian won in a sudden-death playoff against Eamonn Darcy.
Ross McGowan won the Estoril Challenge de Portugal here in 2007 with a final-round 66, three strokes clear.
Top100golfcourses says the holes have been re-sequenced: the old 11th became the new 1st and the old 10th is now the 18th, in front of the hotel.

trivia.text: Top100golfcourses says the six par threes steal the show, all of them short, measured between 143 and 182 yards.
Golfbreaks says a par four with a view of the Atlantic was used for years to promote golf in Portugal.
Where2golf calls it not quite on a par with its neighbour Oitavos Dunes, but a pleasantly testing outing for all levels.
Golfbreaks lists it as par 71 and 6,419 yards.

local.text: Cascais is a former fishing village on the Estoril coast, now an affluent suburb of Lisbon, according to Top100golfcourses.
The course belongs to a resort with a five-star hotel, close to Oitavos Dunes.
